input.name: 共享单车出行 CSV 分析报告
input.requirements: 用 Python、pandas 和 Matplotlib 在本机分析一份合成骑行 CSV，列为trip_id、start_time、end_time、start_station；时间均为同一城市本地时间。按trip_id去重并记录删行数，解析时间，单独记录缺失或结束早于开始的无效行；对有效行计算分钟时长，按出发小时汇总骑行次数，绘制出发站次数Top10条形图。导出清洗后含时长的CSV、按小时汇总CSV和PNG图；图要有标题、轴标签。不要预测、仪表盘、地图、账号或云部署。
input.project_context: 已有 Python 函数、文件读写、调试和统计基础，但第一次用 pandas 处理出行数据，也不熟悉 Matplotlib 的API。希望重点理解时间清洗、分组与可复核的数据口径，不要重新上通用 Python 入门课，也不要假定高级标签就代表熟悉所有库。

analysis.scope: 本机单脚本分析一份共享单车骑行 CSV：按 trip_id 去重并报告删除行数；解析同城本地时间；分别统计缺失时间与结束早于开始（严格早于，相等时间视为有效）的无效行；对有效行计算分钟时长；按出发小时汇总次数；绘制出发站 Top10 条形图；导出清洗后 CSV、按小时汇总 CSV 与带标题和轴标签的 PNG。不做预测、仪表盘、地图、账号或云部署。
analysis.technical_plan: 使用 Python + pandas + Matplotlib 的单一本地脚本，按阶段拆分函数：load_and_dedupe 读取 CSV 并保留首个 trip_id、返回删除行数；parse_and_split 用 pd.to_datetime 解析两列时间并统计解析失败行；split_invalid 单独收集缺失时间行与 end<start 行（end==start 合法）；add_duration 计算 (end-start) 的分钟数；hourly_summary 用 dt.hour 分组计数；station_bar 用 value_counts().head(10) 画横向条形图并设置标题与轴标签；最后统一写出三个产物文件并打印各项计数以便复核。所有口径（去重、无效判定、单位、Top10 顺序）在打印日志与 CSV 中保持一致。
assumptions: 合成 CSV 的时间两列使用 pandas 可解析的统一字符串格式（如 ISO），解析失败行按缺失处理并计数。
Top10 按出发站次数降序，取前 10 个站；不足 10 个时全部展示。
按出发小时汇总使用 0–23 的整点小时，不按日期拆分。
无效行在被去重之后、计算时长之前剔除；去重优先于无效判定。
图表与文件均输出到本机当前工作目录的指定文件名。
学生可修改学生阶段、项目背景与技术选择后重新生成。

functions.acceptance_criteria: 读入后保留每个 trip_id 的首条记录，打印并返回删除行数，使去重前后行数之差等于该数。

functions.name: 解析时间并区分无效行
functions.original_requirement: 解析时间，单独记录缺失或结束早于开始的无效行
functions.acceptance_criteria: 两列时间被解析为日期时间；缺失/解析失败行单独计数，严格 end<start 行单独计数并保留明细；end==start 不计入无效。

functions.name: 计算有效行分钟时长
functions.original_requirement: 对有效行计算分钟时长
functions.acceptance_criteria: 每行时长为 (end_time-start_time) 的分钟数，数据集中不含无效行，时长均 >=0 且 end==start 行时长为 0。

functions.name: 按出发小时汇总骑行次数
functions.original_requirement: 按出发小时汇总骑行次数
functions.acceptance_criteria: 输出 0–23 中实际出现的出发小时及各小时有效骑行次数，合计等于有效行数。

functions.name: 绘制出发站 Top10 条形图
functions.original_requirement: 绘制出发站次数Top10条形图；图要有标题、轴标签
functions.acceptance_criteria: 条形图展示次数最多的前 10 个出发站，降序排列，含非空标题与两轴标签，并可保存为 PNG。

functions.name: 导出清洗后 CSV、按小时 CSV 与 PNG
functions.original_requirement: 导出清洗后含时长的CSV、按小时汇总CSV和PNG图
functions.acceptance_criteria: 三个文件成功写出：清洗数据含时长列，按小时 CSV 含小时与次数，PNG 可正常打开且图形与统计一致。

knowledge_points.name: pandas 读取骑行 CSV 与列结构检查
knowledge_points.description: 用 read_csv 载入合成骑行数据，检查列名、数据类型与行数，为后续清洗建立基线。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 后续去重、解析与计数都依赖正确载入和核对原始列。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解 read_csv 的返回结构，并能用 dtypes、head、shape 快速核对数据口径。
knowledge_points.project_task: 编写读取函数，打印原始行数、列名与每列 dtype，并保存原始行数供删除行数计算。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 运行后终端显示列名、原始行数和各列 dtype，与 CSV 表头一致。

knowledge_points.name: pandas trip_id 去重与删除行数统计
knowledge_points.description: 用 drop_duplicates 按 trip_id 保留首条记录，并用行数差计算删除行数。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 项目要求按 trip_id 去重并记录删除行数，这是可复核口径的第一步。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解 subset/keep 参数含义，并能用去重前后行数差验证删除行数。
knowledge_points.project_task: 实现去重步骤，保留每个 trip_id 第一条记录，返回并打印删除行数。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 去重前后行数之差等于打印的删除行数，且余下 trip_id 唯一。

knowledge_points.name: pandas 时间列解析与无效行分离
knowledge_points.description: 用 to_datetime 解析起止时间，分别筛出缺失/解析失败行与严格 end<start 行并保留明细。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 需单独记录缺失或结束早于开始的无效行，且相等时间仍属有效，必须精确处理边界。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解 errors 处理与布尔筛选，能严格区分缺失、end<start 与 end==start 三种情况。
knowledge_points.project_task: 解析两列时间，生成两个无效行子集并计数，同时验证 end==start 行不被误剔除。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 打印两个无效行数与各自示例行；构造一条 end==start 记录确认它仍在有效数据中。

knowledge_points.name: pandas 时间差计算骑行分钟时长
knowledge_points.description: 用日期时间相减得到 Timedelta，并转换为分钟数新增时长列。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 清洗后 CSV 必须含分钟时长，后续汇总依赖有效行的时长口径。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解日期时间差与单位换算，能确保无效行不参与时长计算且不出现负值。
knowledge_points.project_task: 在有效行上计算时长分钟列，并检查最小值与 end==start 行的时长是否为 0。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 清洗表新增时长列，最小值 >=0，end==start 行的时长恰为 0。

knowledge_points.name: pandas 按出发小时分组计数
knowledge_points.description: 从开始时间提取小时，用 value_counts 或 groupby 统计各出发小时的有效骑行次数。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 项目要求按出发小时汇总骑行次数并导出汇总 CSV。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解 dt.hour 提取与分组计数，能验证汇总次数合计等于有效行数。
knowledge_points.project_task: 生成按小时汇总表，按小时排序并重命名列，导出前核对总次数。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 汇总表各小时次数之和等于有效行数，小时取值为 0–23。

knowledge_points.name: Matplotlib 出发站 Top10 条形图
knowledge_points.description: 用 value_counts().head(10) 准备数据，绘制横向条形图并设置标题与轴标签。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 项目要求绘制 Top10 条形图且图中需有标题和轴标签。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解 Matplotlib 图形对象与坐标轴设置，能控制排序方向并添加标题与两轴标签。
knowledge_points.project_task: 编写绘图函数，绘制出发站次数 Top10 条形图，设置标题、两轴标签并保存 PNG。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 生成的 PNG 显示最多 10 个出发站、次数降序，标题与两轴标签齐全。

knowledge_points.name: pandas 清洗结果与汇总 CSV 导出及复核日志
knowledge_points.description: 用 to_csv 导出清洗后含时长数据与按小时汇总表，并打印去重、无效、有效各计数形成复核日志。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 项目要求导出两个 CSV，并让清洗口径可复核。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解 to_csv 的 index 参数与计数链关系，能用日志核对各阶段行数是否自洽。
knowledge_points.project_task: 实现导出函数，写出两个 CSV 并在终端打印去重删除数、两类无效数、有效行数与汇总合计数。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 两个 CSV 存在且可重新读取，日志中各计数满足：原始行数-删除数-无效数=有效行数。

request.project_context: 共享单车出行 CSV 分析报告 使用 Python + pandas + Matplotlib 的单一本地脚本，按阶段拆分函数：load_and_dedupe 读取 CSV 并保留首个 trip_id、返回删除行数；parse_and_split 用 pd.to_datetime 解析两列时间并统计解析失败行；split_invalid 单独收集缺失时间行与 end<start 行（end==start 合法）；add_duration 计算 (end-start) 的分钟数；hourly_summary 用 dt.hour 分组计数；station_bar 用 value_counts().head(10) 画横向条形图并设置标题与轴标签；最后统一写出三个产物文件并打印各项计数以便复核。所有口径（去重、无效判定、单位、Top10 顺序）在打印日志与 CSV 中保持一致。 已有 Python 函数、文件读写、调试和统计基础，但第一次用 pandas 处理出行数据，也不熟悉 Matplotlib 的API。希望重点理解时间清洗、分组与可复核的数据口径，不要重新上通用 Python 入门课，也不要假定高级标签就代表熟悉所有库。 用 Python、pandas 和 Matplotlib 在本机分析一份合成骑行 CSV，列为trip_id、start_time、end_time、start_station；时间均为同一城市本地时间。按trip_id去重并记录删行数，解析时间，单独记录缺失或结束早于开始的无效行；对有效行计算分钟时长，按出发小时汇总骑行次数，绘制出发站次数Top10条形图。导出清洗后含时长的CSV、按小时汇总CSV和PNG图；图要有标题、轴标签。不要预测、仪表盘、地图、账号或云部署。

request.project_context: 共享单车出行 CSV 分析报告 使用 Python + pandas + Matplotlib 的单一本地脚本，按阶段拆分函数：load_and_dedupe 读取 CSV 并保留首个 trip_id、返回删除行数；parse_and_split 用 pd.to_datetime 解析两列时间并统计解析失败行；split_invalid 单独收集缺失时间行与 end<start 行（end==start 合法）；add_duration 计算 (end-start) 的分钟数；hourly_summary 用 dt.hour 分组计数；station_bar 用 value_counts().head(10) 画横向条形图并设置标题与轴标签；最后统一写出三个产物文件并打印各项计数以便复核。所有口径（去重、无效判定、单位、Top10 顺序）在打印日志与 CSV 中保持一致。 已有 Python 函数、文件读写、调试和统计基础，但第一次用 pandas 处理出行数据，也不熟悉 Matplotlib 的API。希望重点理解时间清洗、分组与可复核的数据口径，不要重新上通用 Python 入门课，也不要假定高级标签就代表熟悉所有库。 用 Python、pandas 和 Matplotlib 在本机分析一份合成骑行 CSV，列为trip_id、start_time、end_time、start_station；时间均为同一城市本地时间。按trip_id去重并记录删行数，解析时间，单独记录缺失或结束早于开始的无效行；对有效行计算分钟时长，按出发小时汇总骑行次数，绘制出发站次数Top10条形图。导出清洗后含时长的CSV、按小时汇总CSV和PNG图；图要有标题、轴标签。不要预测、仪表盘、地图、账号或云部署。

resources.description:
We just published a course on the freeCodeCamp.org YouTube channel that will teach you how to use Pandas through interactive projects. You will develop 7 projects ranging from the basics of Pandas for Data Analysis, to Data Cleaning and Data Wrangling.
DataFrames Practice: Working with English Words
You will get acquainted with the basics of Pandas DataFrames, focusing on understanding and manipulating their structures, all while working with an extensive dictionary of English words.
Filtering and Sorting with Pokemon Data
Dive into the captivating world of Pokemon as you perform fundamental data analysis tasks like filtering and sorting.
This project is not only educational but also fun, making it perfect for those just starting.
The Birthday Paradox in the NBA
Apply these insights to explore shared player birthdays within NBA teams.
Matching Strings by Similarity using Levenshtein Distance
This project introduces advanced techniques such as Combinatorics and the Levenshtein distance to detect irregularities in company names.
Data Cleaning with Google Playstore Dataset
Learn how to identify and rectify null values, duplicate values, outliers, and more, using a dataset scraped from the Google Playstore, which is replete with irregularities.
Premier League Match Analysis
It combines data cleaning with analysis based on grouping operations, using data from the Premier League, the top-tier football league in England.
NBA 2017 Season Analysis: Joining and Groupby Practice
Learn how to merge different dataframes, clean them, and perform analysis and question/answering tasks using the 2017 NBA statistics dataset.

DataFrames Practice: Working with English Words

Premier League Match Analysis
It combines data cleaning with analysis based on grouping operations, using data from the Premier League, the top-tier football league in England.
NBA 2017 Season Analysis: Joining and Groupby Practice
Learn how to merge different dataframes, clean them, and perform analysis and question/answering tasks using the 2017 NBA statistics dataset.

input.name: pygame 单屏迷宫寻出口
input.requirements: 用 Python 和 pygame 做单屏8乘8固定迷宫小游戏。地图用二维列表表示墙、路和出口；方向键每次按下移动一格，不能穿墙或越出地图。到达出口后显示胜利和本轮耗时，按R可重置玩家位置与计时，Esc或关闭窗口可退出。开始前和胜利后都必须能处理按键与关窗，使用帧率上限，耗时依据真实时间而非帧数。不需要自动生成迷宫、寻路提示、敌人、联网或计分排行。
input.project_context: 会 Python 列表、循环、函数，做过 pygame 窗口和绘图，但没写过网格地图和完整胜利/重置状态。希望聚焦网格坐标、阻挡、输入边沿和时间/状态处理。

analysis.scope: 用 Python + pygame 实现单屏 8×8 固定迷宫寻出口小游戏。地图用二维列表存墙/路/出口；方向键每次按下移动一格，不可穿墙或越界；到达出口显示胜利与本轮耗时；R 键重置玩家位置与计时；Esc 或关窗退出；开始前与胜利后都要持续处理按键和关窗；限帧，耗时按真实时间。不做自动生成迷宫、寻路提示、敌人、联网或排行。
analysis.technical_plan: 语言 Python，图形库 pygame（按上下文假定，可改）。核心结构：二维列表常量地图；玩家用 (col,row) 网格坐标；移动前先判断目标格是否合法（在 8×8 内且非墙）。主循环分状态：READY（开始前）、PLAYING、WIN，三态都执行 pygame.event 处理与绘制。移动用 KEYDOWN 事件边沿，不读持续按键状态。计时用 pygame.time.get_ticks() 或 time.monotonic()，按毫秒差值算真实耗时；clock.tick(60) 限帧。到达出口切 WIN 并记录结束时间；R 键在 READY/WIN 重置玩家与起点时间。循环不因胜利而终止，仅在 QUIT/Esc 时退出。
assumptions: 图形库选用 pygame，基于项目上下文，属于可修改假设。
地图为固定 8×8，玩家起点与出口位置在代码中写定。
网格坐标为 (列, 行)，左上角为 (0,0)，墙用 1、路用 0、出口用 2 表示（表示方式可改）。
耗时单位用秒并保留一位小数；显示为近似值也接受。
开始前按方向键不移动，仅 R/Esc 生效。

assumed_knowledge: pygame 窗口创建与基本绘图

knowledge_points.description: 玩家用 (列,行) 表示，移动前检查目标格在 0..7 内且非墙。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 防止穿墙和越界是核心规则。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 掌握在移动前用边界与非墙条件校验目标格。
knowledge_points.project_task: 实现一次按方向键移动一格，并加边界与墙阻挡。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 朝墙或地图边界按方向键时玩家不动，朝路移动一格。

knowledge_points.name: pygame 键盘输入边沿处理
knowledge_points.description: 用 KEYDOWN 事件处理单次移动，避免持续按键导致每帧连走。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 需求是“每次按下移动一格”，需事件边沿而非持续状态。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 区分 KEYDOWN 边沿与 pygame.key.get_pressed 的持续状态。
knowledge_points.project_task: 在事件循环中把方向键 KEYDOWN 映射为一次移动。
concepts: 与 get_pressed 持续状态的区别
knowledge_points.practice_check: 按住方向键不连发，每次重新按下只移动一格。

knowledge_points.name: pygame 游戏状态机与胜利判定
knowledge_points.description: 用 READY/PLAYING/WIN 状态控制行为，玩家进入出口格切换到 WIN 并显示胜利文本。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 开始前、游戏中、胜利后行为不同且都要响应事件。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解状态变量如何决定移动是否生效和画面显示内容。
knowledge_points.project_task: 加入状态变量，到达出口切 WIN 并绘制胜利文字。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 踩到出口格后画面出现“胜利”，且此前开始前不响应移动。

knowledge_points.name: pygame 持续主循环与 R/Esc 键处理
knowledge_points.description: 主循环在所有状态都处理事件：ESC/QUIT 退出，R 重置玩家与计时；胜利后循环不终止。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 胜利后仍要能重置、关窗，不能结束整个循环。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解事件处理与游戏状态解耦，循环只由退出条件结束。
knowledge_points.project_task: 把 R 与 ESC/QUIT 事件统一放到主循环事件处理中。
concepts: 主循环不因胜利而中断
按状态限制哪些键生效
knowledge_points.practice_check: 胜利后按 R 能回到可玩状态，按 Esc 或关窗可退出。

knowledge_points.name: 真实时间计时与限帧
knowledge_points.description: 用 pygame.time.get_ticks() 差值计算耗时，clock.tick(60) 限帧。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 耗时必须按真实时间，不受帧数影响。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解真实时钟差值与帧计数的区别。
knowledge_points.project_task: 记录起点 ticks，显示本轮秒数，并在 R 时重置起点。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 胜利界面秒数与实际游玩时间大致相符，改变帧率不影响读数。

We are going to start by creating a variable at the top of our program called score.
score = 0
Next we are going to increment the score from our main loop where we check if the goblin is hit.
We would like to display this score to the screen. To do this we must first create a font object.
font = pygame.font.SysFont("comicsans", 30, True) # The first argument is the font, next is size # and then True to make our font bold
After we create our font we need to render some text and blit it to the screen.

One green and one red. We will change the width of the green rectangle (which will overlay the red one) each time the enemy is hit.
To do this we must modify the enemy class like so.
Now we have a health bar that will move down as our goblin is hit.

resource.description:
Tutorial #1
In this tutorial series we will be working to create the famous snake game in python with the module pygame. If you are more interested in a general pygame tutorial series click here
Starter Code
To make our lives a bit easier I've set up the main structure for our game already. We are going to be using two main classes (snake and cube).
Creating our Game Loop
In all games we have a loop called a "main loop" or "game loop". This loop will continuously run until the game is exited. It is mainly responsible for checking for events and calling functions and methods based on those events.
We are going to be coding our game loop inside the main() function. We will declare some variables at the top of the function then move into our while loop which will represent our game loop.
```python
def main(): 
    global width, rows, s
    width = 500  # Width of our screen
    height = 500  # Height of our screen
    rows = 20  # Amount of rows

    win = pygame.display.set_mode((width, height))  # Creates our screen object

    s = snake((255,0,0), (10,10))  # Creates a snake object which we will code later

    clock = pygame.time.Clock() # creating a clock object

    flag = True
    # STARTING MAIN LOOP
    while flag:
        pygame.time.delay(50)  # This will delay the game so it doesn't run too quickly
        clock.tick(10)  # Will ensure our game runs at 10 FPS
        redrawWindow(win)  # This will refresh our screen
```
Updating the Screen
It is usually good practice to do all of our drawing of objects from within one function or method. We will be using the redrawWindow function to update the display. We call this function once a frame from our game loop.
We will be adding more to this function later. However, for now we will simply draw the grid lines.
Drawing the Grid
We are now going to work on drawing the lines to represent the 20x20 grid. We will do this in the drawGrid function.
```python
def drawGrid(w, rows, surface):
    sizeBtwn = w // rows  # Gives us the distance between the lines

    x = 0  # Keeps track of the current x
    y = 0  # Keeps track of the current y
    for l in range(rows):  # We will draw one vertical and one horizontal line each loop
        x = x + sizeBtwn
        y = y + sizeBtwn

        pygame.draw.line(surface, (255,255,255), (x,0),(x,w))
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (255,255,255), (0,y),(w,y))
```
Now when we run the program we can see the grid lines being drawn.
Starting the Snake Class
Our snake object is going to contain a list of cubes which will represent the snake body. We are going to store these cubes in a list called body which will be a class variable. We will also have a class variable called turns.
To start our Snake class we will code the init() method and add the class variables.

request.project_context: pygame 单屏迷宫寻出口 语言 Python，图形库 pygame（按上下文假定，可改）。核心结构：二维列表常量地图；玩家用 (col,row) 网格坐标；移动前先判断目标格是否合法（在 8×8 内且非墙）。主循环分状态：READY（开始前）、PLAYING、WIN，三态都执行 pygame.event 处理与绘制。移动用 KEYDOWN 事件边沿，不读持续按键状态。计时用 pygame.time.get_ticks() 或 time.monotonic()，按毫秒差值算真实耗时；clock.tick(60) 限帧。到达出口切 WIN 并记录结束时间；R 键在 READY/WIN 重置玩家与起点时间。循环不因胜利而终止，仅在 QUIT/Esc 时退出。 会 Python 列表、循环、函数，做过 pygame 窗口和绘图，但没写过网格地图和完整胜利/重置状态。希望聚焦网格坐标、阻挡、输入边沿和时间/状态处理。 用 Python 和 pygame 做单屏8乘8固定迷宫小游戏。地图用二维列表表示墙、路和出口；方向键每次按下移动一格，不能穿墙或越出地图。到达出口后显示胜利和本轮耗时，按R可重置玩家位置与计时，Esc或关闭窗口可退出。开始前和胜利后都必须能处理按键与关窗，使用帧率上限，耗时依据真实时间而非帧数。不需要自动生成迷宫、寻路提示、敌人、联网或计分排行。

resources.description:
Basic Movement & Key Presses
What is Pygame?
Pygame is a third party module designed for creating 2D games with python. It has very simple and intuitive syntax that can allows us to create powerful games quickly. Pygame uses surfaces for drawing. This means whenever we want to draw something to the screen it must be converted to a surface. There are many methods and functions within pygame that can do this easily for us.
Installing Pygame
Installing pygame can be as easy as:
Opening your command prompt Typing pip install pygame
However, in many cases this will not work. Below are guides for installing pygame on both windows and mac.
Windows: How to Install Pygame on Windows
Mac OS: How to Install Pygame on Mac
Linux: refer to the Mac OS Guide.
Creating a Window
After we import pygame it is a good idea to initialize it, like so:
Once we've done that we need to setup a windows that will represent our game.
Now when we run the program we get something that looks like this.
This is great but we'd like to give our game a more creative name than "pygame window". To do this we can can type the following.
pygame.display.set_caption("First Game")
That's better!
Moving a Character
We are going to start by defining a few variables to represent our character.
x = 50 y = 50 width = 40 height = 60 vel = 5
Now we are going to setup our Main-loop or game-loop. All games have some sort of loop that executes constantly. This loop is responsible for tasks such as checking for events (such as keyboard events or collision), moving objects, updating the display and eventually ending the game. In our game we will use a while loop.
Inside the loop we will implement a time delay so we can control the speed of the game. We will also start by checking for some specific events.
Now we can draw a rectangle to the screen to represent our character. We will draw the rectangle in the main loop so that it is constantly redrawn each time we loop.
Now we can start checking for events so that we can move our character.
Inside the if statements we will change the value of the variables x and y to move the character. This brings me to the coordinate system. In pygame the top left corner of the screen is (0,0) and the bottom right is (width, height). This means to move up we subtract from the y of our character and to move down we add to the y.
Now when we run the program and start moving our rectangle we can still see all of the previous rectangles.
To fix this we simply have to draw over the previous shape before redrawing another one. We can use window.fill(color) to do this.
And now we can move our character around!

resources.description:
Tutorial #1
In this tutorial series we will be working to create the famous snake game in python with the module pygame. If you are more interested in a general pygame tutorial series click here
Starter Code
To make our lives a bit easier I've set up the main structure for our game already. We are going to be using two main classes (snake and cube).
Creating our Game Loop
In all games we have a loop called a "main loop" or "game loop". This loop will continuously run until the game is exited. It is mainly responsible for checking for events and calling functions and methods based on those events.
We are going to be coding our game loop inside the main() function. We will declare some variables at the top of the function then move into our while loop which will represent our game loop.
```python
def main(): 
    global width, rows, s
    width = 500  # Width of our screen
    height = 500  # Height of our screen
    rows = 20  # Amount of rows

    win = pygame.display.set_mode((width, height))  # Creates our screen object

    s = snake((255,0,0), (10,10))  # Creates a snake object which we will code later

    clock = pygame.time.Clock() # creating a clock object

    flag = True
    # STARTING MAIN LOOP
    while flag:
        pygame.time.delay(50)  # This will delay the game so it doesn't run too quickly
        clock.tick(10)  # Will ensure our game runs at 10 FPS
        redrawWindow(win)  # This will refresh our screen
```
Updating the Screen
It is usually good practice to do all of our drawing of objects from within one function or method. We will be using the redrawWindow function to update the display. We call this function once a frame from our game loop.
We will be adding more to this function later. However, for now we will simply draw the grid lines.
Drawing the Grid
We are now going to work on drawing the lines to represent the 20x20 grid. We will do this in the drawGrid function.
```python
def drawGrid(w, rows, surface):
    sizeBtwn = w // rows  # Gives us the distance between the lines

    x = 0  # Keeps track of the current x
    y = 0  # Keeps track of the current y
    for l in range(rows):  # We will draw one vertical and one horizontal line each loop
        x = x + sizeBtwn
        y = y + sizeBtwn

        pygame.draw.line(surface, (255,255,255), (x,0),(x,w))
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (255,255,255), (0,y),(w,y))
```
Now when we run the program we can see the grid lines being drawn.
Starting the Snake Class
Our snake object is going to contain a list of cubes which will represent the snake body. We are going to store these cubes in a list called body which will be a class variable. We will also have a class variable called turns.
To start our Snake class we will code the init() method and add the class variables.

```python
    rows = 20  # Amount of rows

    win = pygame.display.set_mode((width, height))  # Creates our screen object

```

```python
def drawGrid(w, rows, surface):
    sizeBtwn = w // rows  # Gives us the distance between the lines
```

What is Pygame?
Pygame is a third party module designed for creating 2D games with python. It has very simple and intuitive syntax that can allows us to create powerful games quickly. Pygame uses surfaces for drawing. This means whenever we want to draw something to the screen it must be converted to a surface. There are many methods and functions within pygame that can do this easily for us.

Opening your command prompt Typing pip install pygame

This is great but we'd like to give our game a more creative name than "pygame window". To do this we can can type the following.

That's better!
Moving a Character
We are going to start by defining a few variables to represent our character.
x = 50 y = 50 width = 40 height = 60 vel = 5
Now we are going to setup our Main-loop or game-loop. All games have some sort of loop that executes constantly. This loop is responsible for tasks such as checking for events (such as keyboard events or collision), moving objects, updating the display and eventually ending the game. In our game we will use a while loop.
Inside the loop we will implement a time delay so we can control the speed of the game. We will also start by checking for some specific events.
Now we can draw a rectangle to the screen to represent our character. We will draw the rectangle in the main loop so that it is constantly redrawn each time we loop.
Now we can start checking for events so that we can move our character.
Inside the if statements we will change the value of the variables x and y to move the character. This brings me to the coordinate system. In pygame the top left corner of the screen is (0,0) and the bottom right is (width, height). This means to move up we subtract from the y of our character and to move down we add to the y.
Now when we run the program and start moving our rectangle we can still see all of the previous rectangles.
To fix this we simply have to draw over the previous shape before redrawing another one. We can use window.fill(color) to do this.
And now we can move our character around!

request.project_context: pygame 单屏迷宫寻出口 语言 Python，图形库 pygame（按上下文假定，可改）。核心结构：二维列表常量地图；玩家用 (col,row) 网格坐标；移动前先判断目标格是否合法（在 8×8 内且非墙）。主循环分状态：READY（开始前）、PLAYING、WIN，三态都执行 pygame.event 处理与绘制。移动用 KEYDOWN 事件边沿，不读持续按键状态。计时用 pygame.time.get_ticks() 或 time.monotonic()，按毫秒差值算真实耗时；clock.tick(60) 限帧。到达出口切 WIN 并记录结束时间；R 键在 READY/WIN 重置玩家与起点时间。循环不因胜利而终止，仅在 QUIT/Esc 时退出。 会 Python 列表、循环、函数，做过 pygame 窗口和绘图，但没写过网格地图和完整胜利/重置状态。希望聚焦网格坐标、阻挡、输入边沿和时间/状态处理。 用 Python 和 pygame 做单屏8乘8固定迷宫小游戏。地图用二维列表表示墙、路和出口；方向键每次按下移动一格，不能穿墙或越出地图。到达出口后显示胜利和本轮耗时，按R可重置玩家位置与计时，Esc或关闭窗口可退出。开始前和胜利后都必须能处理按键与关窗，使用帧率上限，耗时依据真实时间而非帧数。不需要自动生成迷宫、寻路提示、敌人、联网或计分排行。

resources.description:
Projectiles
In this tutorial we are going to be implementing projectiles.
Projectile Class
The first thing we are going to do is create a projectile class.
Modifying the Player Class
Because we are going to be shooting bullets left or right we need to ensure our character is always facing left or right. This required modifying the player.draw method and adding another attribute of standing to our player.
Modifying the Main Loop
We also need to modify our main loop to ensure our character is always facing left or right.
Setting up The Projectiles
The first step is to create a list which will store all of our bullet objects.
bullets = [] # This goes right above the while loop
Now we are going to add a for loop into our main loop that will move our bullets and remove them if they have left the screen.
# Goes inside the while loop for bullet in bullets: if bullet.x < 500 and bullet.x > 0: bullet.x += bullet.vel # Moves the bullet by its vel else: bullets.pop(bullets.index(bullet)) # This will remove the bullet if it is off the screen
Shooting the Bullet
We are first going to change our jump key to be the up arrow (just change pygame.K_SPACE to pygame.K_UP). Then we are going to create a new if statement that will check if the space bar is clicked. If it is we will create a new bullet, give it a velocity and start moving it.
And the last thing to do is to draw our bullets inside redrawGameWindow().
```python
def redrawGameWindow():
    win.blit(bg, (0,0))
    man.draw(win)
    for bullet in bullets:
        bullet.draw(win)

    pygame.display.update()
```
Now we can fire bullets!

resources.description:
Collision & Hit Boxes
In many games we need to check for different types of collision. Whether that be collision of our mouse with a button or collision between images and/or objects. In our case we want to check if our goblin has hit the player or if our bullets have hit the goblin.
Hit Boxes
The term "hit box" is often used to represent the box around an object which represents its "hittable space". Since we often use complex objects and shapes to depict characters or other items in a game we create a hit box for all of these items. This makes it much easier to check for collision as collision between non-rectangular shapes is extremely complicated. We attempt to make these boxes fit the characters shape as precisely as possible but it is difficult to make them perfect.
We will start by creating hit boxes for all of our objects. Then we check if these boxes collide with one another using some basic math.
The first hit box we define will be for our player class.
Since our player moves we will have to constantly redefine the hit box from within the draw method of our player class. To do this we will simply copy the line from above into the draw method.
Our player class should now look like the following.
We will repeat this process in the enemy class. And after adding in the hit box we will also define a new method called hit.
If we run the program we can see the hit boxes for our character.
Collision
The fist collision we will check for is between the bullets and the enemy. Every time we move a bullet we will check if it has collided with the enemy. Since we already have a for loop setup to check if the bullets leave the screen we will do our collision check in there.
We are going to say these objects have collided if the x and y coordinate of the bullet sit inside the hit box of the enemy. We check this with the following code.
Bullet Glitch
There is a small glitch you may have noticed which causes our bullets to stick together or shoot multiple at the same time. To fix this we must do the following.
First we are going to create a variable called shootLoop outside of our main loop.
shootLoop = 0
After that we will place the following code at the top of our while loop.
if shootLoop > 0: shootLoop += 1 if shootLoop > 3: shootLoop = 0
Then we will modify our space bar event check the following way.
if keys[pygame.K_SPACE] and shootLoop == 0: ... # Add the "and shootLoop == 0"

resources.description:
Basic Movement & Key Presses
What is Pygame?
Pygame is a third party module designed for creating 2D games with python. It has very simple and intuitive syntax that can allows us to create powerful games quickly. Pygame uses surfaces for drawing. This means whenever we want to draw something to the screen it must be converted to a surface. There are many methods and functions within pygame that can do this easily for us.
Installing Pygame
Installing pygame can be as easy as:
Opening your command prompt Typing pip install pygame
However, in many cases this will not work. Below are guides for installing pygame on both windows and mac.
Windows: How to Install Pygame on Windows
Mac OS: How to Install Pygame on Mac
Linux: refer to the Mac OS Guide.
Creating a Window
After we import pygame it is a good idea to initialize it, like so:
Once we've done that we need to setup a windows that will represent our game.
Now when we run the program we get something that looks like this.
This is great but we'd like to give our game a more creative name than "pygame window". To do this we can can type the following.
pygame.display.set_caption("First Game")
That's better!
Moving a Character
We are going to start by defining a few variables to represent our character.
x = 50 y = 50 width = 40 height = 60 vel = 5
Now we are going to setup our Main-loop or game-loop. All games have some sort of loop that executes constantly. This loop is responsible for tasks such as checking for events (such as keyboard events or collision), moving objects, updating the display and eventually ending the game. In our game we will use a while loop.
Inside the loop we will implement a time delay so we can control the speed of the game. We will also start by checking for some specific events.
Now we can draw a rectangle to the screen to represent our character. We will draw the rectangle in the main loop so that it is constantly redrawn each time we loop.
Now we can start checking for events so that we can move our character.
Inside the if statements we will change the value of the variables x and y to move the character. This brings me to the coordinate system. In pygame the top left corner of the screen is (0,0) and the bottom right is (width, height). This means to move up we subtract from the y of our character and to move down we add to the y.
Now when we run the program and start moving our rectangle we can still see all of the previous rectangles.
To fix this we simply have to draw over the previous shape before redrawing another one. We can use window.fill(color) to do this.
And now we can move our character around!

resources.description:
Tutorial #1
In this tutorial series we will be working to create the famous snake game in python with the module pygame. If you are more interested in a general pygame tutorial series click here
Starter Code
To make our lives a bit easier I've set up the main structure for our game already. We are going to be using two main classes (snake and cube).
Creating our Game Loop
In all games we have a loop called a "main loop" or "game loop". This loop will continuously run until the game is exited. It is mainly responsible for checking for events and calling functions and methods based on those events.
We are going to be coding our game loop inside the main() function. We will declare some variables at the top of the function then move into our while loop which will represent our game loop.
```python
def main(): 
    global width, rows, s
    width = 500  # Width of our screen
    height = 500  # Height of our screen
    rows = 20  # Amount of rows

    win = pygame.display.set_mode((width, height))  # Creates our screen object

    s = snake((255,0,0), (10,10))  # Creates a snake object which we will code later

    clock = pygame.time.Clock() # creating a clock object

    flag = True
    # STARTING MAIN LOOP
    while flag:
        pygame.time.delay(50)  # This will delay the game so it doesn't run too quickly
        clock.tick(10)  # Will ensure our game runs at 10 FPS
        redrawWindow(win)  # This will refresh our screen
```
Updating the Screen
It is usually good practice to do all of our drawing of objects from within one function or method. We will be using the redrawWindow function to update the display. We call this function once a frame from our game loop.
We will be adding more to this function later. However, for now we will simply draw the grid lines.
Drawing the Grid
We are now going to work on drawing the lines to represent the 20x20 grid. We will do this in the drawGrid function.
```python
def drawGrid(w, rows, surface):
    sizeBtwn = w // rows  # Gives us the distance between the lines

    x = 0  # Keeps track of the current x
    y = 0  # Keeps track of the current y
    for l in range(rows):  # We will draw one vertical and one horizontal line each loop
        x = x + sizeBtwn
        y = y + sizeBtwn

        pygame.draw.line(surface, (255,255,255), (x,0),(x,w))
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (255,255,255), (0,y),(w,y))
```
Now when we run the program we can see the grid lines being drawn.
Starting the Snake Class
Our snake object is going to contain a list of cubes which will represent the snake body. We are going to store these cubes in a list called body which will be a class variable. We will also have a class variable called turns.
To start our Snake class we will code the init() method and add the class variables.

resources.description:
Tutorial #4
Collision With Snack
Now that we’ve created the snack we need to draw it and see if the head of our snake collides with it.
Our redrawWindow() function should now look like this:
```python
def redrawWindow(surface):
    global rows, width, s, snack # ADD snack to this line
    surface.fill((0,0,0))
    s.draw(surface)
    snack.draw(surface) # NEW
    drawGrid(width,rows, surface)
    pygame.display.update()
```
To check for collision we will add the following lines into our game loop within the main() function.
if s.body[0] == snake.pos: # Checks if the head collides with the snack s.addCube() # Adds a new cube to the snake snack = cube(randomSnack(rows, s), color=(0,255,0)) # creates a new snack object
Snake Class – addCube() Method
The last step to adding a cube is to add it to the end of our snake object. We will do this from the addCube() method.
Ending the Game
We lose the game when our snake object collides with itself. To check this we add the following line to our main() function inside the game loop.
for x in range(len(s.body)): if s.body[x].pos in list(map(lambda z:z.pos,s.body[x+1:])): # This will check if any of the positions in our body list overlap print('Score: ', len(s.body)) message_box('You Lost!', 'Play again...') s.reset((10,10)) break
Snake Class – reset() Method
Now we will code the reset() method from within the snake class. All this will do is reset the snake so we can play again afterwards.
Displaying a Message Box
When the user losses we want to display a message box telling them that they lost.
We are going to do this using tkinter and inside of our message_box() function.
And now our game is finished!

evidence.text:
Collision & Hit Boxes
In many games we need to check for different types of collision. Whether that be collision of our mouse with a button or collision between images and/or objects. In our case we want to check if our goblin has hit the player or if our bullets have hit the goblin.
Hit Boxes
The term "hit box" is often used to represent the box around an object which represents its "hittable space". Since we often use complex objects and shapes to depict characters or other items in a game we create a hit box for all of these items. This makes it much easier to check for collision as collision between non-rectangular shapes is extremely complicated. We attempt to make these boxes fit the characters shape as precisely as possible but it is difficult to make them perfect.
We will start by creating hit boxes for all of our objects. Then we check if these boxes collide with one another using some basic math.
The first hit box we define will be for our player class.
Since our player moves we will have to constantly redefine the hit box from within the draw method of our player class. To do this we will simply copy the line from above into the draw method.

We will repeat this process in the enemy class. And after adding in the hit box we will also define a new method called hit.
If we run the program we can see the hit boxes for our character.
Collision
The fist collision we will check for is between the bullets and the enemy. Every time we move a bullet we will check if it has collided with the enemy. Since we already have a for loop setup to check if the bullets leave the screen we will do our collision check in there.

In many games we need to check for different types of collision. Whether that be collision of our mouse with a button or collision between images and/or objects. In our case we want to check if our goblin has hit the player or if our bullets have hit the goblin.
Hit Boxes
The term "hit box" is often used to represent the box around an object which represents its "hittable space". Since we often use complex objects and shapes to depict characters or other items in a game we create a hit box for all of these items. This makes it much easier to check for collision as collision between non-rectangular shapes is extremely complicated. We attempt to make these boxes fit the characters shape as precisely as possible but it is difficult to make them perfect.
We will start by creating hit boxes for all of our objects. Then we check if these boxes collide with one another using some basic math.

Updating the Screen
It is usually good practice to do all of our drawing of objects from within one function or method. We will be using the redrawWindow function to update the display. We call this function once a frame from our game loop.
We will be adding more to this function later. However, for now we will simply draw the grid lines.
Drawing the Grid
We are now going to work on drawing the lines to represent the 20x20 grid. We will do this in the drawGrid function.
```python
def drawGrid(w, rows, surface):
    sizeBtwn = w // rows  # Gives us the distance between the lines

    x = 0  # Keeps track of the current x
    y = 0  # Keeps track of the current y
    for l in range(rows):  # We will draw one vertical and one horizontal line each loop
        x = x + sizeBtwn
        y = y + sizeBtwn

        pygame.draw.line(surface, (255,255,255), (x,0),(x,w))
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (255,255,255), (0,y),(w,y))
```
Now when we run the program we can see the grid lines being drawn.
Starting the Snake Class
Our snake object is going to contain a list of cubes which will represent the snake body. We are going to store these cubes in a list called body which will be a class variable. We will also have a class variable called turns.
To start our Snake class we will code the init() method and add the class variables.

Projectiles
In this tutorial we are going to be implementing projectiles.
Projectile Class
The first thing we are going to do is create a projectile class.
Modifying the Player Class
Because we are going to be shooting bullets left or right we need to ensure our character is always facing left or right. This required modifying the player.draw method and adding another attribute of standing to our player.
Modifying the Main Loop
We also need to modify our main loop to ensure our character is always facing left or right.
Setting up The Projectiles
The first step is to create a list which will store all of our bullet objects.
bullets = [] # This goes right above the while loop
Now we are going to add a for loop into our main loop that will move our bullets and remove them if they have left the screen.
# Goes inside the while loop for bullet in bullets: if bullet.x < 500 and bullet.x > 0: bullet.x += bullet.vel # Moves the bullet by its vel else: bullets.pop(bullets.index(bullet)) # This will remove the bullet if it is off the screen
Shooting the Bullet
We are first going to change our jump key to be the up arrow (just change pygame.K_SPACE to pygame.K_UP). Then we are going to create a new if statement that will check if the space bar is clicked. If it is we will create a new bullet, give it a velocity and start moving it.
And the last thing to do is to draw our bullets inside redrawGameWindow().
```python
def redrawGameWindow():
    win.blit(bg, (0,0))
    man.draw(win)
    for bullet in bullets:
        bullet.draw(win)

    pygame.display.update()
```
Now we can fire bullets!

evidence.text:
Tutorial #2
Snake Class - Move Method
Now we will continue coding the snake class by completing the move() method.
This method will first check for any events.
The most complicated part of this game is turning the snake. We need to remember where we turned our snake and which direction so that when the cubes after the head reach that spot we can turn them as well. This is why whenever we turn we add the position of our head to a turn dictionary where the value is the direction we turned. This way when the other cubes reach this position we know which way to turn them.
Drawing the Snake
To draw the snake we are simply going to draw each cube object in the body. We will do this in the snakes draw() method.
Now before we can start actually using snake.draw we must code the cube class.

evidence.text:
Basic Movement & Key Presses
What is Pygame?
Pygame is a third party module designed for creating 2D games with python. It has very simple and intuitive syntax that can allows us to create powerful games quickly. Pygame uses surfaces for drawing. This means whenever we want to draw something to the screen it must be converted to a surface. There are many methods and functions within pygame that can do this easily for us.
Installing Pygame
Installing pygame can be as easy as:
Opening your command prompt Typing pip install pygame
However, in many cases this will not work. Below are guides for installing pygame on both windows and mac.
Windows: How to Install Pygame on Windows
Mac OS: How to Install Pygame on Mac
Linux: refer to the Mac OS Guide.
Creating a Window
After we import pygame it is a good idea to initialize it, like so:
Once we've done that we need to setup a windows that will represent our game.

What is Pygame?
Pygame is a third party module designed for creating 2D games with python. It has very simple and intuitive syntax that can allows us to create powerful games quickly. Pygame uses surfaces for drawing. This means whenever we want to draw something to the screen it must be converted to a surface. There are many methods and functions within pygame that can do this easily for us.

Character Animation & Sprites
IMPORTANT Please download the images for this tutorial from my GitHub or the download button below.
GitHub: Click Here!
Download Zip:
Please place all of these images in the same directory as your python script.
Character Animation
After we've downloaded our images we can start getting ready to anime our character.
The first step is to create a few variables which will be used to determine which way we are facing and keep track of the current image we are showing.
# This goes outside the while loop, near the top of our program left = False right = False walkCount = 0
Now we need to load our images. To load an image in pygame we use pygame.image.load(path). Since we need to load so many images we will be storing some of them in lists for easier accessing later on.
This is the code to load all of our images (I recommend you copy and paste).
It is often good practice to do all of our drawing from within a function. This means we are going to move our old drawing code that is inside the main loop into a function and make a few modifications.
Now we are going to set our left and right variables appropriately from inside the main loop.
And finally we can start working on drawing our character to the screen.
NOTE: This is very complex, please refer to the video for more in depth explanations.
The last thing we need to do is change our framerate.
To do this we are going to create a clock object using clock = pygame.time.Clock() outside of our main loop and write clock.tick(27) inside our main loop.
You may notice when running the program that the background does not cover the entire screen, to fix this simply change there screen height to 480.
pygame.display.set_mode((500, 480))

evidence.text:
Tutorial #4
Collision With Snack
Now that we’ve created the snack we need to draw it and see if the head of our snake collides with it.
Our redrawWindow() function should now look like this:
```python
def redrawWindow(surface):
    global rows, width, s, snack # ADD snack to this line
    surface.fill((0,0,0))
    s.draw(surface)
    snack.draw(surface) # NEW
    drawGrid(width,rows, surface)
    pygame.display.update()
```
To check for collision we will add the following lines into our game loop within the main() function.
if s.body[0] == snake.pos: # Checks if the head collides with the snack s.addCube() # Adds a new cube to the snake snack = cube(randomSnack(rows, s), color=(0,255,0)) # creates a new snack object
Snake Class – addCube() Method
The last step to adding a cube is to add it to the end of our snake object. We will do this from the addCube() method.
Ending the Game
We lose the game when our snake object collides with itself. To check this we add the following line to our main() function inside the game loop.
for x in range(len(s.body)): if s.body[x].pos in list(map(lambda z:z.pos,s.body[x+1:])): # This will check if any of the positions in our body list overlap print('Score: ', len(s.body)) message_box('You Lost!', 'Play again...') s.reset((10,10)) break
Snake Class – reset() Method
Now we will code the reset() method from within the snake class. All this will do is reset the snake so we can play again afterwards.
Displaying a Message Box
When the user losses we want to display a message box telling them that they lost.
We are going to do this using tkinter and inside of our message_box() function.
And now our game is finished!

input.name: 离线番茄钟学习网页
input.requirements: 用 HTML、CSS、JavaScript 做本机浏览器可用的番茄钟网页。专注固定25分钟、休息固定5分钟，能开始、暂停、继续和重置；倒计时结束后切换到下一阶段并暂停等待用户开始；每完成一个专注阶段次数加1。切到后台标签页再回来，剩余时间仍应准确，不能只靠setInterval每次减1。显示当前阶段、剩余时间和已完成次数，手机窄屏可用，键盘能操作所有按钮。不需要账号、联网、通知、音效或后端。
input.project_context: 会基础 HTML/CSS 和 JavaScript 变量、if，还没有做过完整交互项目；希望每个单元有可验证的小成果。

analysis.scope: 用 HTML、CSS、JavaScript 制作一个纯本机浏览器运行的番茄钟网页：专注固定 25 分钟、休息固定 5 分钟；支持开始、暂停、继续、重置；阶段倒计时结束自动切换到下一阶段并暂停等待用户开始；每完成一个专注阶段计数加 1；显示当前阶段、剩余时间与已完成次数；切换标签页后剩余时间仍准确；手机窄屏可用；键盘可操作所有按钮。不含账号、联网、通知、音效或后端。
analysis.technical_plan: 单一静态页面（index.html + style.css + script.js），按要求使用原生 HTML/CSS/JavaScript，不引入框架或构建工具。倒计时以每阶段结束的绝对时间戳为目标，每次显示刷新用 Date.now() 求剩余毫秒并取整格式化，setInterval 只负责定期刷新显示，避免累减。用一个状态对象记录阶段（专注/休息）、是否运行、结束时间戳、暂停剩余毫秒、已完成专注次数；集中渲染函数更新阶段文字、mm:ss 与次数，并据此更新按钮可用状态。开始/暂停/继续/重置由原生 <button> 点击事件驱动，保留浏览器默认键盘激活与 focus-visible 焦点样式，不拦截默认按键行为，保证 Tab/Enter/空格可用。窄屏用 viewport meta 与弹性/相对单位布局。
assumptions: 未指定 CSS 框架、构建工具或图形库，采用原生 CSS 与单个 script.js 文件；如学生更换工具可重新生成。
休息结束后同样切回专注并暂停，等待用户点开始；这是对“切换到下一阶段并暂停”的对称解释，可修改。
仅完成专注阶段时次数加 1，休息阶段完成不加。
按钮采用原生 <button>，优先用浏览器默认键盘激活而非自定义快捷键。
不做页面关闭后的持久化，刷新即重置。
暂停后继续时以保存的剩余毫秒重新计算结束时间戳。

functions.name: 开始、暂停、继续控制倒计时
functions.original_requirement: 能开始、暂停、继续和重置
functions.acceptance_criteria: 点击开始后倒计时按真实时间递减；暂停后显示冻结；继续后从冻结的剩余时间接着走，不跳变。

functions.name: 固定时长阶段与结束自动切换并暂停
functions.original_requirement: 专注固定25分钟、休息固定5分钟……倒计时结束后切换到下一阶段并暂停等待用户开始
functions.acceptance_criteria: 专注到 00:00 后自动切到休息并处于暂停态；休息结束后切回专注并暂停；两者均需用户点开始才继续计时。

functions.name: 完成专注计数
functions.original_requirement: 每完成一个专注阶段次数加1
functions.acceptance_criteria: 每完成一次专注阶段次数恰好加 1；休息阶段结束不加；重置时是否清零见假设。

functions.name: 阶段、剩余时间与次数显示
functions.original_requirement: 显示当前阶段、剩余时间和已完成次数
functions.acceptance_criteria: 页面始终显示当前阶段名称、mm:ss 格式剩余时间与已完成次数，状态变化后立即更新。

functions.name: 切后台后剩余时间仍准确
functions.original_requirement: 切到后台标签页再回来，剩余时间仍应准确，不能只靠setInterval每次减1
functions.acceptance_criteria: 计时中切到其他标签页停留一段时间再回来，显示剩余时间与真实经过时间一致（误差在 1 秒显示取整内）。

functions.name: 窄屏可用布局
functions.original_requirement: 手机窄屏可用
functions.acceptance_criteria: 在约 360px 宽视口下，阶段、时间、次数与全部按钮完整可见且不横向溢出。

functions.name: 键盘操作所有按钮
functions.original_requirement: 键盘能操作所有按钮
functions.acceptance_criteria: 仅用 Tab 可依次聚焦所有按钮并有可见焦点；Enter 或空格能触发每个按钮，功能与鼠标点击一致。

functions.name: 重置
functions.original_requirement: 能开始、暂停、继续和重置
functions.acceptance_criteria: 重置后回到专注阶段初始 25:00 且处于暂停态，计时停止。

knowledge_points.name: 番茄钟页面结构与语义化按钮
knowledge_points.description: 用 HTML 搭建阶段、时间、次数三个显示区域与开始/暂停/继续/重置四个原生 button，并配可读标签。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 显示区域与语义化按钮是后续 JS 更新和键盘操作的基础。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解语义化 HTML 结构如何同时服务于显示更新和无障碍键盘操作。
knowledge_points.project_task: 写出包含阶段文字、时间显示、次数显示和四个 <button> 的静态页面骨架。
concepts: 语义化分区与文本占位
knowledge_points.practice_check: 打开页面能看到三块显示内容和四个可用 Tab 聚焦的按钮。

knowledge_points.name: CSS 弹性布局与窄屏适配
knowledge_points.description: 用相对单位、flex 布局与 viewport meta 让内容在窄屏下纵向排列不溢出。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 用户要求手机窄屏可用，需要布局而不只是功能。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解 viewport 设置、弹性布局和相对字号如何保证小屏可读。
knowledge_points.project_task: 为页面骨架加样式，使宽屏横排、窄屏纵向堆叠，时间数字足够大。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 浏览器缩到约 360px 宽，所有内容与按钮可见且无横向滚动条。

knowledge_points.name: JavaScript 状态对象与阶段时长常量
knowledge_points.description: 用对象记录当前阶段、是否运行、剩余毫秒与完成次数，并定义 25/5 分钟常量。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 分离状态与显示是正确实现切换、计数和暂停的前提。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解用单一状态对象驱动界面，而不是散落的全局变量。
knowledge_points.project_task: 定义专注/休息常量、初始状态对象和一个根据状态更新页面文本的渲染函数。
concepts: 渲染函数集中更新 DOM
knowledge_points.practice_check: 手动修改状态值后调用渲染函数，页面阶段、时间、次数同步变化。

knowledge_points.name: 时间戳倒计时与后台标签页准确性
knowledge_points.description: 保存阶段结束的绝对时间戳，用 Date.now() 计算剩余毫秒并渲染，而非每次减 1。
knowledge_points.why_needed: setInterval 在后台会被节流，只有按真实时间差计算才能保证切回后准确。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解基于截止时间戳与时间差计算剩余量，比累减计数器更稳健。
knowledge_points.project_task: 实现用结束时间戳和 Date.now() 求剩余毫秒、格式化为 mm:ss 并更新的渲染。
concepts: 剩余毫秒计算与显示取整
knowledge_points.practice_check: 计时中切到其他标签页等十几秒再回来，剩余时间与真实经过一致。

knowledge_points.name: 开始暂停继续重置的状态转换
knowledge_points.description: 用按钮事件切换运行标志，暂停时冻结剩余毫秒，继续时重算截止时间，重置回初始状态。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 暂停继续与重置是本项目核心交互，需要明确的状态转换。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解暂停保存剩余量、继续重建截止时间戳、重置恢复初始状态的逻辑。
knowledge_points.project_task: 为四个按钮绑定点击处理，实现开始、暂停、继续、重置并调用渲染。
concepts: 运行标志与暂停剩余量
继续时重算截止时间戳
knowledge_points.practice_check: 依次点开始、暂停、继续、重置，观察显示按预期冻结、续走并回到 25:00。

knowledge_points.name: 阶段结束切换与专注计数
knowledge_points.description: 剩余归零时切换专注/休息、置为暂停并等待开始，完成专注时次数加 1。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 固定 25/5 切换、结束后暂停、专注计数都需要在归零时正确处理。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解在倒计时归零时执行阶段切换、暂停与按阶段条件计数的组合逻辑。
knowledge_points.project_task: 在渲染检测到剩余小于等于 0 时切阶段、暂停并仅对专注阶段加 1。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 用缩短的时长测试：专注结束切休息并暂停、次数加 1；休息结束切专注且次数不变。

knowledge_points.name: 原生按钮键盘操作与焦点样式
knowledge_points.description: 保留原生 button 默认键盘激活，保证 Tab 顺序和可见焦点样式。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 用户要求键盘能操作所有按钮，需验证不破坏默认行为。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解原生按钮自带的键盘激活，以及为何不应自定义拦截按键。
knowledge_points.project_task: 添加清晰的 :focus-visible 焦点样式，并检查按钮未被脚本阻止默认键盘行为。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 仅用键盘 Tab 到每个按钮并按 Enter/空格，功能与鼠标一致且焦点清晰可见。

request.project_context: 离线番茄钟学习网页 单一静态页面（index.html + style.css + script.js），按要求使用原生 HTML/CSS/JavaScript，不引入框架或构建工具。倒计时以每阶段结束的绝对时间戳为目标，每次显示刷新用 Date.now() 求剩余毫秒并取整格式化，setInterval 只负责定期刷新显示，避免累减。用一个状态对象记录阶段（专注/休息）、是否运行、结束时间戳、暂停剩余毫秒、已完成专注次数；集中渲染函数更新阶段文字、mm:ss 与次数，并据此更新按钮可用状态。开始/暂停/继续/重置由原生 <button> 点击事件驱动，保留浏览器默认键盘激活与 focus-visible 焦点样式，不拦截默认按键行为，保证 Tab/Enter/空格可用。窄屏用 viewport meta 与弹性/相对单位布局。 会基础 HTML/CSS 和 JavaScript 变量、if，还没有做过完整交互项目；希望每个单元有可验证的小成果。 用 HTML、CSS、JavaScript 做本机浏览器可用的番茄钟网页。专注固定25分钟、休息固定5分钟，能开始、暂停、继续和重置；倒计时结束后切换到下一阶段并暂停等待用户开始；每完成一个专注阶段次数加1。切到后台标签页再回来，剩余时间仍应准确，不能只靠setInterval每次减1。显示当前阶段、剩余时间和已完成次数，手机窄屏可用，键盘能操作所有按钮。不需要账号、联网、通知、音效或后端。

request.project_context: 离线番茄钟学习网页 单一静态页面（index.html + style.css + script.js），按要求使用原生 HTML/CSS/JavaScript，不引入框架或构建工具。倒计时以每阶段结束的绝对时间戳为目标，每次显示刷新用 Date.now() 求剩余毫秒并取整格式化，setInterval 只负责定期刷新显示，避免累减。用一个状态对象记录阶段（专注/休息）、是否运行、结束时间戳、暂停剩余毫秒、已完成专注次数；集中渲染函数更新阶段文字、mm:ss 与次数，并据此更新按钮可用状态。开始/暂停/继续/重置由原生 <button> 点击事件驱动，保留浏览器默认键盘激活与 focus-visible 焦点样式，不拦截默认按键行为，保证 Tab/Enter/空格可用。窄屏用 viewport meta 与弹性/相对单位布局。 会基础 HTML/CSS 和 JavaScript 变量、if，还没有做过完整交互项目；希望每个单元有可验证的小成果。 用 HTML、CSS、JavaScript 做本机浏览器可用的番茄钟网页。专注固定25分钟、休息固定5分钟，能开始、暂停、继续和重置；倒计时结束后切换到下一阶段并暂停等待用户开始；每完成一个专注阶段次数加1。切到后台标签页再回来，剩余时间仍应准确，不能只靠setInterval每次减1。显示当前阶段、剩余时间和已完成次数，手机窄屏可用，键盘能操作所有按钮。不需要账号、联网、通知、音效或后端。

input.name: Arduino LED 按钮反应时间小游戏
input.requirements: 用 Arduino Uno、一个带限流电阻的LED和一个按钮做低压反应时间小游戏。按钮使用INPUT_PULLUP接地，串口监视器显示提示和结果；按一下开始一轮，先随机等待2到5秒再亮LED，亮灯后按按钮显示反应毫秒数。等待期间若提前按下则判抢按，之后可按按钮开始新一轮。全程仍能识别按钮，不能用delay阻塞随机等待；按钮需要去抖，长按不能连续启动多轮。说明断电接线、LED极性和共地，不接市电、电机或继电器。
input.project_context: 做过一次点亮 LED，知道上传Arduino程序，但没有做过按钮输入和状态机项目。希望先完成安全接线和单个输入输出，再整合游戏。

analysis.scope: 使用Arduino Uno、一个带限流电阻的LED和一个按钮制作低压反应时间小游戏。按钮采用INPUT_PULLUP接地，串口监视器显示提示和结果。游戏流程：按按钮开始一轮，随机等待2到5秒后点亮LED，亮灯后按按钮显示反应毫秒数；若等待期间按下则判为抢按，之后可再按按钮开始新一轮。全程必须能识别按钮，不得用delay阻塞随机等待；按钮需去抖，长按不能连续启动多轮。包含断电接线、LED极性、共地说明，不涉及市电、电机或继电器。
analysis.technical_plan: 使用Arduino Uno、一个LED（串联限流电阻）和一个按钮。按钮接法：一端接GND，另一端接D2引脚，使用pinMode(2, INPUT_PULLUP)。LED阳极经电阻接D9引脚，阴极接GND，注意极性和共地。程序采用非阻塞状态机：状态包括IDLE（等待开始）、WAITING（随机等待2-5秒）、LIGHT_ON（灯亮等待反应）、EARLY（抢按提示）。随机等待使用random(2000, 5001)获取毫秒数，配合millis()计时，不使用delay。按钮去抖采用稳定时间窗口：每5ms采样一次，连续4次（20ms）电平相同才确认状态变化，从去抖后的下降沿检测一次按下。主循环始终运行，不阻塞按钮采样。串口监视器9600波特率，显示提示和反应时间。
assumptions: 使用Arduino Uno和Arduino IDE，串口监视器波特率设为9600。
按钮和LED的引脚可修改，方案中默认按钮接D2、LED接D9。
随机等待范围2到5秒包含端点，程序使用random(2000, 5001)实现。
去抖参数（稳定采样次数和间隔）是可修改假设，默认每5ms采样一次，连续4次相同电平确认。
硬件接线为低压直流，不涉及市电、电机或继电器。
学生可更换开发板型号、引脚或去抖参数并重新生成方案。

assumed_knowledge: 能在Arduino IDE中编写并上传简单程序
知道LED需要串联限流电阻并区分极性
了解Arduino基本数字输入输出函数
learner_profile.adjustment_note: 你是初学者，假设你只做过点亮LED。如果实际经验不同，或想调整项目范围、硬件引脚和去抖参数，可以随时修改并重新生成学习方案。

functions.name: 安全断电接线与LED/按钮电路搭建
functions.original_requirement: 说明断电接线、LED极性和共地，不接市电、电机或继电器。按钮使用INPUT_PULLUP接地。
functions.acceptance_criteria: 在断电状态下完成接线：LED阳极经限流电阻接D9，阴极接GND；按钮一端接GND，另一端接D2；所有地线共地；上电后LED不异常常亮，按钮可被读取；不接入市电、电机或继电器。

functions.name: 按钮去抖与单次按下检测
functions.original_requirement: 按钮需要去抖，长按不能连续启动多轮。
functions.acceptance_criteria: 按住按钮不放时，串口只打印一次按下事件，不会连续触发开始；松开后再次按下可产生新事件。去抖采用稳定时间窗口，而非仅比较上次电平。

functions.name: 非阻塞随机等待与提前按下判定
functions.original_requirement: 随机等待2到5秒再亮LED；等待期间若提前按下则判抢按；全程仍能识别按钮，不能用delay阻塞随机等待。
functions.acceptance_criteria: 在等待期间按下按钮，串口立即显示抢按提示；等待期间按钮检测正常，不因等待而丢失按下；到达随机时间后LED点亮。

functions.name: 亮灯后测量并显示反应毫秒数
functions.original_requirement: 亮灯后按按钮显示反应毫秒数。
functions.acceptance_criteria: LED点亮后按下按钮，串口显示反应时间（毫秒），数值为非负整数；按钮去抖后只记录第一次有效按下。

functions.name: 抢按后开始新一轮
functions.original_requirement: 等待期间若提前按下则判抢按，之后可按按钮开始新一轮。
functions.acceptance_criteria: 抢按提示后，再次按下按钮可开始新一轮随机等待；长按不会连续启动多轮。

knowledge_points.name: Arduino低压电路安全接线与LED极性
knowledge_points.description: 学习断电接线顺序、LED阳极阴极识别、限流电阻作用与共地连接，完成安全的上电前检查。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 正确接线是项目运行和安全的前提，避免LED损坏或短路。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解LED极性、限流电阻和共地的作用，能独立完成并检查低压接线。
knowledge_points.project_task: 在断电状态下将LED经电阻接D9，按钮一端接GND另一端接D2，确认所有地线共地。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 上电后LED不异常常亮，按钮可被读取；用万用表检查GND连通。

knowledge_points.name: Arduino按钮INPUT_PULLUP与串口监视器调试
knowledge_points.description: 学习pinMode(INPUT_PULLUP)配置内部上拉，用digitalRead读取按钮状态，并通过串口监视器打印状态变化。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 项目需要可靠读取按钮并观察去抖效果，串口是主要反馈工具。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 能配置内部上拉按钮，并在串口监视器中正确打印按钮原始状态。
knowledge_points.project_task: 编写程序读取D2按钮状态，并每100ms在串口监视器打印一次原始电平值。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 串口监视器显示：未按时为1，按下时为0。

knowledge_points.name: 按钮去抖的稳定时间窗口实现
knowledge_points.description: 学习用millis()定时采样，连续多次电平一致才确认按钮状态变化，并检测从松开到按下的单次边沿。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 机械按钮会产生抖动，不处理会导致一次按下被误判为多次，长按也会连续触发。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解去抖需要稳定时间窗口而非仅比较上次电平，并能实现单次按下检测。
knowledge_points.project_task: 在程序中每5ms读取按钮，连续4次电平相同才更新稳定状态；在稳定状态从HIGH变为LOW时产生一次按下事件。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 快速按下松开一次，串口只打印一次“按下”；按住不放3秒，也只打印一次；抖动时不会打印多次。

knowledge_points.name: 非阻塞随机等待与millis计时
knowledge_points.description: 学习用random()生成2到5秒的毫秒数，用millis()记录开始时间，在主循环中检查是否达到等待时间，避免delay阻塞。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 随机等待期间仍需持续检测按钮，用delay会导致无法识别提前按下。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解非阻塞等待模式，能实现不冻结按钮检测的随机延时。
knowledge_points.project_task: 在等待状态中生成2000到5000毫秒的随机等待时长，用millis()比较已过时间，同时持续执行按钮去抖检测。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 等待期间按下按钮能立即被检测到，3次测试亮灯时间随机分布在2-5秒内且不阻塞。

knowledge_points.name: 反应时间游戏状态机与主循环
knowledge_points.description: 设计IDLE、WAITING、LIGHT_ON、EARLY四个状态的状态机，在loop中根据状态和按钮事件切换，LED亮灭与串口提示对应。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 整合按钮事件、随机等待、抢按处理、反应计时和重新开始，需要清晰的状态管理。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 能将游戏规则转化为状态机，并在不阻塞主循环的前提下管理状态切换。
knowledge_points.project_task: 实现状态机：IDLE等待按钮，WAITING随机等待，LIGHT_ON记录反应并显示毫秒数，EARLY提示抢按后可再按开始。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 完整流程可运行：按按钮→等待→亮灯→再按显示反应毫秒；等待中抢按显示提示，再按可开始新一轮。

request.project_context: Arduino LED 按钮反应时间小游戏 使用Arduino Uno、一个LED（串联限流电阻）和一个按钮。按钮接法：一端接GND，另一端接D2引脚，使用pinMode(2, INPUT_PULLUP)。LED阳极经电阻接D9引脚，阴极接GND，注意极性和共地。程序采用非阻塞状态机：状态包括IDLE（等待开始）、WAITING（随机等待2-5秒）、LIGHT_ON（灯亮等待反应）、EARLY（抢按提示）。随机等待使用random(2000, 5001)获取毫秒数，配合millis()计时，不使用delay。按钮去抖采用稳定时间窗口：每5ms采样一次，连续4次（20ms）电平相同才确认状态变化，从去抖后的下降沿检测一次按下。主循环始终运行，不阻塞按钮采样。串口监视器9600波特率，显示提示和反应时间。 做过一次点亮 LED，知道上传Arduino程序，但没有做过按钮输入和状态机项目。希望先完成安全接线和单个输入输出，再整合游戏。 用 Arduino Uno、一个带限流电阻的LED和一个按钮做低压反应时间小游戏。按钮使用INPUT_PULLUP接地，串口监视器显示提示和结果；按一下开始一轮，先随机等待2到5秒再亮LED，亮灯后按按钮显示反应毫秒数。等待期间若提前按下则判抢按，之后可按按钮开始新一轮。全程仍能识别按钮，不能用delay阻塞随机等待；按钮需要去抖，长按不能连续启动多轮。说明断电接线、LED极性和共地，不接市电、电机或继电器。

input.name: 校园自习室使用情况本地看板
input.requirements: 用 Python、pandas 和 Streamlit 做本机浏览器使用的自习室 CSV 看板。通过文件上传读取合成CSV，列为date、room、visits、capacity、open_minutes、occupied_seat_minutes。date按YYYY-MM-DD解析；room不能为空；visits为非负整数，capacity和open_minutes为正整数，occupied_seat_minutes为非负数且不得超过capacity*open_minutes；不合格行排除并显示数量，不做未要求的去重。提供起止日期（两端包含）和房间多选筛选，默认全部有效日期及全部房间，房间选空表示无结果而非自动全部。所有指标与图使用同一份筛选后有效数据：显示到访总人次sum(visits)、占用座位分钟sum(occupied_seat_minutes)、加权使用率sum(occupied_seat_minutes)/sum(capacity*open_minutes)，使用率以百分比保留1位小数，不能平均各行百分比；有效零到访记录必须保留。按room汇总到访人次并用Streamlit自带条形图显示。尚未上传、CSV缺列或格式错误、筛选无匹配时给清晰提示且页面可继续操作；空结果时指标显示“—”，不算除零或显示NaN，不画误导性图。只用本地文件，不需要账号、联网数据、数据库、预测、地图或云部署。
input.project_context: 已会Python函数、pandas read_csv、布尔筛选和groupby，第一次使用Streamlit。希望学习上传/控件/重运行与一致的数据口径；不重上Python或pandas整门入门课。项目范围适中，学习路线合并为不超过6个可练习单元。

analysis.scope: 用 Python、pandas 与 Streamlit 在本机浏览器做一个自习室使用情况看板：上传合成 CSV，按规则校验并排除不合格行、显示排除数量（不去重）；用起止日期（两端包含）与房间多选筛选；在筛选后有效数据上计算到访总人次、占用座位分钟、加权使用率（%保留1位小数），并画按房间到访人次条形图；未上传、缺列、格式错误、筛选无匹配均有提示，空结果指标显示“—”且不画图。不需要账号、联网、数据库、预测、地图或云部署。
analysis.technical_plan: 技术栈按指定使用 Python + pandas + Streamlit，全部在本机运行。结构：1) 用 st.file_uploader 读取 CSV；2) 独立校验函数：解析 date（YYYY-MM-DD）、检查 room 非空、visits 非负整数、capacity 与 open_minutes 为正整数、occupied_seat_minutes 非负且不超过 capacity*open_minutes，返回有效数据与被排除行数；3) 用 st.date_input 取起止日期（两端包含）与 st.multiselect 取房间；房间选空时返回空结果；4) 指标与图都基于同一份 filtered 数据：sum 聚合计算加权使用率=sum(occupied)/sum(capacity*open_minutes)，用 f-string 格式化百分比保留1位小数；5) 空结果指标显示“—”且不调用 st.bar_chart。为便于学习，拆成不超过6个练习单元，从上传与重运行、校验、筛选、聚合口径、条件化展示逐步搭建。校验与聚合逻辑写成可单独测试的普通函数。
assumptions: CSV 为合成数据，列名与要求一致（date、room、visits、capacity、open_minutes、occupied_seat_minutes），编码默认为 UTF-8。
起止日期默认取有效数据的 min/max，房间多选默认选中全部有效房间。
“缺列或格式错误”指必需列缺失或整表无法解析，与逐行排除分开提示。
日期筛选与起止两端包含；若用户选到无匹配日期区间按“筛选无匹配”处理。
学生第一次用 Streamlit，按 intermediate 略去 Python/pandas 入门，只讲项目所需部分。

assumed_knowledge: Python 函数与基本数据结构
未使用过 Streamlit，需要从上传与重运行学起
learner_profile.adjustment_note: 当前按中级安排，略过 Python 与 pandas 入门，直接从 Streamlit 上传、校验与指标口径讲起。若想更基础或调整项目范围/技术选择，可修改后重新生成路线。

functions.name: 上传并读取本地 CSV
functions.original_requirement: 通过文件上传读取合成CSV
functions.acceptance_criteria: 未上传时显示提示并可继续操作；上传后能用 pandas 读入 DataFrame，CSV 无法解析时给出错误提示且页面不崩溃。

functions.name: 逐行校验与排除计数
functions.original_requirement: date按YYYY-MM-DD解析；room不能为空；visits为非负整数，capacity和open_minutes为正整数，occupied_seat_minutes为非负数且不得超过capacity*open_minutes；不合格行排除并显示数量，不做未要求的去重
functions.acceptance_criteria: 构造含各类不合格行的样本，只保留全部条件通过的记录，并显示被排除行数；不进行去重；零 visits 的有效行被保留。

functions.name: 缺列与格式错误提示
functions.original_requirement: CSV缺列或格式错误时给清晰提示且页面可继续操作
functions.acceptance_criteria: 缺任一必需列或整表解析失败时给出明确说明，不进入指标计算，页面仍可上传新文件。

functions.name: 日期区间与房间多选筛选
functions.original_requirement: 提供起止日期（两端包含）和房间多选筛选，默认全部有效日期及全部房间，房间选空表示无结果而非自动全部
functions.acceptance_criteria: 默认显示全部有效数据；起止日期两端包含；房间选空时返回空结果，不自动回退为全部房间。

functions.name: 统一口径的三项指标
functions.original_requirement: 显示到访总人次sum(visits)、占用座位分钟sum(occupied_seat_minutes)、加权使用率sum(occupied_seat_minutes)/sum(capacity*open_minutes)，使用率以百分比保留1位小数，不能平均各行百分比
functions.acceptance_criteria: 三项均用同一份筛选后数据计算；使用率为 sum 比值而非各行之比的平均，百分比保留1位小数；零到访有效记录参与保留但不影响正确性。

functions.name: 按房间到访人次条形图
functions.original_requirement: 按room汇总到访人次并用Streamlit自带条形图显示
functions.acceptance_criteria: 对筛选后数据 groupby room 求 sum(visits) 并用 st.bar_chart 显示；结果为空时不画图。

functions.name: 空结果条件化展示
functions.original_requirement: 筛选无匹配时给清晰提示；空结果时指标显示“—”，不算除零或显示NaN，不画误导性图
functions.acceptance_criteria: 筛选无匹配时显示提示，三项指标均显示“—”，不出现除零错误或 NaN，且不绘制条形图。

knowledge_points.name: Streamlit 文件上传与脚本重运行
knowledge_points.description: 理解 st.file_uploader 返回的文件对象与脚本自上而下重运行机制。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 上传文件是本看板所有数据的入口，需理解控件触发重运行。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 明白每次交互都会重跑脚本，上传结果需在控件处读取。
knowledge_points.project_task: 搭一个最小页面，用 st.file_uploader 上传 CSV，用 pandas 读入并显示表头和行数。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 上传文件后页面显示列名与前几行；不传文件时只显示提示。

knowledge_points.name: pandas 列校验与逐行规则验证
knowledge_points.description: 对必需列存在性检查，并按日期、非空、整数、范围规则逐行保留有效行、统计排除数。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 数据质量决定指标可信，且要求排除不合格行并计数。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 会把校验写成返回有效数据与排除数的普通函数，并区分缺列与行级不合格。
knowledge_points.project_task: 编写 validate(df) 函数：检查必需列，解析 date、校验 room/visits/capacity/open_minutes/occupied 约束，返回有效数据与被排除行数。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 对含负数、零容量、日期非法、超占用行的样本，只剩合规行，排除数正确且零 visits 行保留。

knowledge_points.name: Streamlit 日期区间与多选控件
knowledge_points.description: 用 st.date_input 与 st.multiselect 构造筛选条件，处理空选择与默认全部。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 筛选控件是看板交互核心，空选择的语义需明确处理。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 能设置默认值并让房间选空返回空结果而非全部。
knowledge_points.project_task: 添加起止日期（两端包含）与房间多选（默认全部），实现筛选函数。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 默认展示全部数据；房间全不选时结果为空；起止两端日期记录被包含。

knowledge_points.name: 筛选后数据的加权使用率聚合
knowledge_points.description: 在同一份 filtered 数据上用 sum 聚合求三项指标，使用率为总量比而非行均值。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 口径一致与加权算法是要求明确的核心指标。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 理解为何不能平均各行百分比，会写 sum(占用)/sum(容量*时长) 并格式化。
knowledge_points.project_task: 写 compute_metrics(filtered)：返回 visits 总和、occupied 总和、加权使用率（%保留1位小数）。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 用两行不同容量数据验证结果是加权比，且格式为带1位小数的百分数。

knowledge_points.name: groupby 汇总与 Streamlit 条形图
knowledge_points.description: 按房间汇总 visits 并用内置 bar_chart 展示。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 按房间可视化是明确需求。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 会用 groupby 汇总并只对有数据的结果画图。
knowledge_points.project_task: 对 filtered groupby room 求 sum(visits)，非空时 st.bar_chart 显示。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 非空时出现按房间的条形图；空数据时不出现图表。

knowledge_points.name: 空结果的安全展示
knowledge_points.description: 当筛选无匹配或缺列时显示提示、指标“—”，避免除零与 NaN 及误导性图。
knowledge_points.why_needed: 要求空结果不崩溃且不误导。
knowledge_points.learning_goal: 会在计算前判断空数据并分支展示。
knowledge_points.project_task: 在指标与图表前加入空数据与错误状态判断，显示“—”和提示，阻止除零。
knowledge_points.practice_check: 筛选无匹配时三项显示“—”，无 NaN 报错，且无图表；页面仍可继续操作。

resource.description: 课程中文标题：Streamlit与Python：构建与部署真实世界数据应用 课程英文标题：Streamlit with Python: Build and Deploy Real-World Data Apps 课程时长：16小时22分钟 核心技术：Streamlit、Python、数据可视化、数据库与API集成、云部署 行业应用：数据分析与可视化、机器学习模型部署、商业智能仪表盘、内部工具开发 一、课程核心模块与技术亮点 1. Streamlit核心机制与快速开发 • 深入解析Streamlit无前端代码、脚本即应用的执行模型，理解其“用户交互触发脚本重运行”的核心机制。 • 强调极速开发特性，学员无需HTML/CSS/JavaScript知识，仅用Python脚本即可构建完整交互式Web应用。 2. 交互式UI构建与数据可视化实战 • 系统教授丰富UI组件（按钮、滑块、表单、数据表格编辑器）的使用与布局控制。 • 集成主流数据可视化库（Matplotlib、Seaborn、Plotly、Altair），教授如何根据数据场景选择并创建交互式图表。 3. 应用状态管理与性能优化 • 重点讲解st.session_state用于管理用户会话数据，实现复杂交互逻辑。 • 教授缓存（st.cache_data, st.cache_resource）技术，优化数据加载与计算密集型任务性能，构建响应迅速的生产级应用。 4. 高级应用架构与集成 • 构建多页面应用程序，实现清晰的项目结构与跨页面状态共享。 • 实战集成SQL数据库、云数据库及REST API，创建完全数据驱动的应用程序。 5. 生产部署与全流程项目实践 • 涵盖从环境配置、密钥管理到云平台部署（Streamlit Community Cloud, AWS, GCP, Azure）的完整生产工作流。 • 通过两个大型实战项目（端到端Streamlit应用、个人财务追踪与预算规划器）巩固所学，将概念应用于从设计到部署的完整生命周期。 技术亮点： • 纯Python实现全栈应用：颠覆传统Web开发流程，专注于数据逻辑而非前后端协作。 • 从原型到生产的无缝路径：课程特别强调部署与生产最佳实践，确保应用可分享、可扩展。 • 面向真实场景的课程设计：内容聚焦于构建实际可用的数据仪表盘、ML演示工具和内部应用，避免玩具示例。

resource.description: 课程中文标题：Streamlit与Python：构建与部署真实世界数据应用 课程英文标题：Streamlit with Python: Build and Deploy Real-World Data Apps 课程时长：16小时22分钟 核心技术：Streamlit、Python、数据可视化、数据库与API集成、云部署 行业应用：数据分析与可视化、机器学习模型部署、商业智能仪表盘、内部工具开发 一、课程核心模块与技术亮点 1. Streamlit核心机制与快速开发 • 深入解析Streamlit无前端代码、脚本即应用的执行模型，理解其“用户交互触发脚本重运行”的核心机制。 • 强调极速开发特性，学员无需HTML/CSS/JavaScript知识，仅用Python脚本即可构建完整交互式Web应用。 2. 交互式UI构建与数据可视化实战 • 系统教授丰富UI组件（按钮、滑块、表单、数据表格编辑器）的使用与布局控制。 • 集成主流数据可视化库（Matplotlib、Seaborn、Plotly、Altair），教授如何根据数据场景选择并创建交互式图表。 3. 应用状态管理与性能优化 • 重点讲解st.session_state用于管理用户会话数据，实现复杂交互逻辑。 • 教授缓存（st.cache_data, st.cache_resource）技术，优化数据加载与计算密集型任务性能，构建响应迅速的生产级应用。 4. 高级应用架构与集成 • 构建多页面应用程序，实现清晰的项目结构与跨页面状态共享。 • 实战集成SQL数据库、云数据库及REST API，创建完全数据驱动的应用程序。 5. 生产部署与全流程项目实践 • 涵盖从环境配置、密钥管理到云平台部署（Streamlit Community Cloud, AWS, GCP, Azure）的完整生产工作流。 • 通过两个大型实战项目（端到端Streamlit应用、个人财务追踪与预算规划器）巩固所学，将概念应用于从设计到部署的完整生命周期。 技术亮点： • 纯Python实现全栈应用：颠覆传统Web开发流程，专注于数据逻辑而非前后端协作。 • 从原型到生产的无缝路径：课程特别强调部署与生产最佳实践，确保应用可分享、可扩展。 • 面向真实场景的课程设计：内容聚焦于构建实际可用的数据仪表盘、ML演示工具和内部应用，避免玩具示例。

Streamlit核心机制与快速开发 • 深入解析Streamlit无前端代码、脚本即应用的执行模型，理解其“用户交互触发脚本重运行”的核心机制。 • 强调极速开发特性，学员无需HTML/CSS/JavaScript知识，仅用Python脚本即可构建完整交互式Web应用。 2. 交互式UI构建与数据可视化实战 • 系统教授丰富UI组件（按钮、滑块、表单、数据表格编辑器）的使用与布局控制。 • 集成主流数据可视化库（Matplotlib、Seaborn、Plotly、Altair），教授如何根据数据场景选择并创建交互式图表。 3. 应用状态管理与性能优化 • 重点讲解st.session_state用于管理用户会话数据，实现复杂交互逻辑。 • 教授缓存（st.cache_data, st.cache_resource）技术，优化数据加载与计算密集型任务性能，构建响应迅速的生产级应用。 4. 高级应用架构与集成 • 构建多页面应用程序，实现清晰的项目结构与跨页面状态共享。 • 实战集成SQL数据库、云数据库及REST API，创建完全数据驱动的应用程序。 5. 生产部署与全流程项目实践 • 涵盖从环境配置、密钥管理到云平台部署（Streamlit Community Cloud, AWS, GCP, Azure）的完整生产工作流。 • 通过两个大型实战项目（端到端Streamlit应用、个人财务追踪与预算规划器）巩固所学，将概念应用于从设计到部署的完整生命周期。 技术亮点： • 纯Python实现全栈应用：颠覆传统Web开发流程，专注于数据逻辑而非前后端协作。 • 从原型到生产的无缝路径：课程特别强调部署与生产最佳实践，确保应用可分享、可扩展。 • 面向真实场景的课程设计：内容聚焦于构建实际可用的数据仪表盘、ML演示工具和内部应用，避免玩具示例。

resources.description: 课程中文标题：Streamlit与Python：构建与部署真实世界数据应用 课程英文标题：Streamlit with Python: Build and Deploy Real-World Data Apps 课程时长：16小时22分钟 核心技术：Streamlit、Python、数据可视化、数据库与API集成、云部署 行业应用：数据分析与可视化、机器学习模型部署、商业智能仪表盘、内部工具开发 一、课程核心模块与技术亮点 1. Streamlit核心机制与快速开发 • 深入解析Streamlit无前端代码、脚本即应用的执行模型，理解其“用户交互触发脚本重运行”的核心机制。 • 强调极速开发特性，学员无需HTML/CSS/JavaScript知识，仅用Python脚本即可构建完整交互式Web应用。 2. 交互式UI构建与数据可视化实战 • 系统教授丰富UI组件（按钮、滑块、表单、数据表格编辑器）的使用与布局控制。 • 集成主流数据可视化库（Matplotlib、Seaborn、Plotly、Altair），教授如何根据数据场景选择并创建交互式图表。 3. 应用状态管理与性能优化 • 重点讲解st.session_state用于管理用户会话数据，实现复杂交互逻辑。 • 教授缓存（st.cache_data, st.cache_resource）技术，优化数据加载与计算密集型任务性能，构建响应迅速的生产级应用。 4. 高级应用架构与集成 • 构建多页面应用程序，实现清晰的项目结构与跨页面状态共享。 • 实战集成SQL数据库、云数据库及REST API，创建完全数据驱动的应用程序。 5. 生产部署与全流程项目实践 • 涵盖从环境配置、密钥管理到云平台部署（Streamlit Community Cloud, AWS, GCP, Azure）的完整生产工作流。 • 通过两个大型实战项目（端到端Streamlit应用、个人财务追踪与预算规划器）巩固所学，将概念应用于从设计到部署的完整生命周期。 技术亮点： • 纯Python实现全栈应用：颠覆传统Web开发流程，专注于数据逻辑而非前后端协作。 • 从原型到生产的无缝路径：课程特别强调部署与生产最佳实践，确保应用可分享、可扩展。 • 面向真实场景的课程设计：内容聚焦于构建实际可用的数据仪表盘、ML演示工具和内部应用，避免玩具示例。

evidence.text: 【国语】Streamlit与Python：构建与部署真实世界数据应用 教程

课程中文标题：Streamlit与Python：构建与部署真实世界数据应用 课程英文标题：Streamlit with Python: Build and Deploy Real-World Data Apps 课程时长：16小时22分钟 核心技术：Streamlit、Python、数据可视化、数据库与API集成、云部署 行业应用：数据分析与可视化、机器学习模型部署、商业智能仪表盘、内部工具开发 一、课程核心模块与技术亮点 1. Streamlit核心机制与快速开发 • 深入解析Streamlit无前端代码、脚本即应用的执行模型，理解其“用户交互触发脚本重运行”的核心机制。 • 强调极速开发特性，学员无需HTML/CSS/JavaScript知识，仅用Python脚本即可构建完整交互式Web应用。 2. 交互式UI构建与数据可视化实战 • 系统教授丰富UI组件（按钮、滑块、表单、数据表格编辑器）的使用与布局控制。 • 集成主流数据可视化库（Matplotlib、Seaborn、Plotly、Altair），教授如何根据数据场景选择并创建交互式图表。 3. 应用状态管理与性能优化 • 重点讲解st.session_state用于管理用户会话数据，实现复杂交互逻辑。 • 教授缓存（st.cache_data, st.cache_resource）技术，优化数据加载与计算密集型任务性能，构建响应迅速的生产级应用。 4. 高级应用架构与集成 • 构建多页面应用程序，实现清晰的项目结构与跨页面状态共享。 • 实战集成SQL数据库、云数据库及REST API，创建完全数据驱动的应用程序。 5. 生产部署与全流程项目实践 • 涵盖从环境配置、密钥管理到云平台部署（Streamlit Community Cloud, AWS, GCP, Azure）的完整生产工作流。 • 通过两个大型实战项目（端到端Streamlit应用、个人财务追踪与预算规划器）巩固所学，将概念应用于从设计到部署的完整生命周期。 技术亮点： • 纯Python实现全栈应用：颠覆传统Web开发流程，专注于数据逻辑而非前后端协作。 • 从原型到生产的无缝路径：课程特别强调部署与生产最佳实践，确保应用可分享、可扩展。 • 面向真实场景的课程设计：内容聚焦于构建实际可用的数据仪表盘、ML演示工具和内部应用，避免玩具示例。
